messages.content: Predict the participant’s actual contribution in a one-shot public goods game with four real people. Each person receives 400 euro cents (4 euros) and privately chooses an integer number of cents from 0 to 400 to contribute to a common fund; the rest is kept. All four contributions are added, doubled, and divided equally among the four people. Before any later punishment, each person receives their retained money plus half the sum of all four contributions. No other player’s contribution is known when choosing. There is no repeated interaction. After contributions are revealed, everybody can choose to spend money from their current payoff to reduce other players’ payoffs: spending 1 cent costs the punisher 1 cent and reduces the targeted person’s payoff by 4 cents. This later punishment opportunity is already announced before contributing. Each person’s game payoff, after subsequent decisions, is paid in addition to a fixed participation fee of 2 euros. Predict the contribution now. Return only one integer, the number of euro cents contributed.
